QUOTE: In assembly builds it is an empty `asm volatile` that ties `x` to a register. In C builds it returns `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`... The compiler cannot prove the value, so it cannot fold the mask back into a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the asm path is an empty `asm volatile` tying the value to a register, used to hide the value from the optimiser (an optimisation barrier).
